Hey, anyone know wheter any hideout got main menu soundtrack? I didn't unlocked all of them so i can't check.

My winter orb elementalist is nearly impossible to play, almost every pack of 10+ mobs guarantee freeze (0.2-1.5s)
Standard PS4, ssd

Standard ps4, Winter orb elementalist - big fps drops (very often to like 0 causing game freeze for like 1s), i plan to make new build because of that (fps drop is caused by animation of exploding frozen minion)

I wonder why there's no ingame graphic settings, because game looks very good, i would love to turn off all shadows and lower a bit lighting effects...

It's not that easy as you think. There's 3 reasons why people rejecting asking price. First - it's called prive fixing(its very common on PC). Second thing is way easier to understand, if a guy posting item lets say for 1 chaos. He is going to sleep, waking up and see few offers for 1 chaos - he need to reject two of them. Third thing - guy posting item and immediately getting few offers - in that situation he will probably reject all of them and set new - higher price

It's about game optimization, GGG skyrocketed graphic settings to show new poe players how good game looks like (so they can spread good info about poe) and they don't care that when it comes to endgame part we have unplayable fps drop, freezes etc.

They just should add graphics settings - that's all but i don't expect that.
Changing PS4 output settings to 720p doesn't gives any fps boost, it's even worse.

Finally, there's no "high fps drop"  or something like that in their "console known issues" topic so i guess they won't listen to anyone about that.

items.title: Finally.
items.text: Finally.
Special thanks to Leonhardt who crafted best possible craftable mods for my Worb build

1. Buy ilvl 85 shaper sceptre
2. Alt it until you get T1 elemental dmg to chaos
3. If ele ele dmg to chaos isn't alone use orb of annulment to remove 2nd mod, if you deleted dmg to chaos mod use orb of scouring and go back to point 2.
4. Regal it
5. Again, you have to delete 2nd mod using orb of annulment, if you deleted ele dmg to chaos scour and go back to point 2.
6. If you finally deleted all unnecessary mods and your sceptre is rare with 1 mod (ele to dmg) craft  "can have multiple crafted modifiers" and craft rest at bench
For me it was around 7ex but i had luck annuling 2nd mod at first try

I also crafted warlord's mark ring (cost me around 100 alts+regal) https://www.reddit.com/r/pathofexileps4/comments/bcd9bu/experienced_crafters_need_help_3_prefixes_left_no/?utm_medium=android_app&utm_source=share

Yes it's prefix, you need to roll ilvl 85 ring using alts (or chaoses if you're rich) until you get warlord's mark mod, theb you need to regal it with hope for best, after that depends on how good item is you can multicraft/exalt it or leave as it is. It takes around 400-1000 orbs of alterations at average
Ops, aspect of the spider is a random modifier you can get for hunting beasts (just sayin, you already know that probably)

I bought bisco's collar amulet early on for 1ex and I've done elder guardians, elder, and shaper guardians with it on my Winter Orb build. IMO there's no point to make full MF build because if you want to make it budget you have to use very bad items with 5-12% quantity which mean you can't do high tier maps, so everything you can farm is currency.

Bisco's collar and later on 2x ventor's gamble ring is all you need. 

Finally when you dream about Headhunter belt come true you can move to fully MF. 


PS. I love MF builds, farming currency and gear is all i want to do after i end up uber elder
He don't take any fee but remember that you should always tip if someone is doing any crafts for free. You can ask him at POE console discord
